tei:div.tei:p: 103) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur pa'i drag bzlog spu gri'i 'khor lo bzhugs: 104)

na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: dpal chen he ru ka la gus pas 'dud: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skyes bu rigs can gyis: rdo rje phur pa'i rim gnyis nyams len cing: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog pa'i thabs: drag bzlog spu gri'i 'khor lo 'di ru bstan: skal ldan bskyed rdzogs ldan pas nyams su longs: sa ma ya: de nas lag tu len pa'i rim pa ni: drag po'i lcags snod gas chag med pa'i nang: gtor ma lha grangs ma nor tshul bzhin bshams: mtha' mar drag po'i shing la ngar btab pa'i: rtsang dang mtshe yungs sha khrag sogs kyis brgyan: ru tra nag po'i rgyu mas mtha' dkris bya: de nas rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: gtum drag rngams pa'i nga ros 'di 105) skad brjod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ mthing nag e las grub pa'i zhing khams su: thod mkhar me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: chos sku skye med dbyings las sprul pa'i lha: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu khro bo'i rgyal: gdul dka' 'dul mdzad drag khros rngams pa'i sku: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: 'gags med rang byung lhun grub rdzogs pa'i gar: thugs rje thabs kyis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa: zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngams: khams gsum g.yul ngo sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: 106)spyan dgu sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa yis: nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs smar me 'phro: ma rig rkyen snang sdang ba'i= dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa yis: srid pa'i gdon tshogs= thod skam lnga yis dbu la rtse bran mdzes: 'byung lnga'i g.yo 'khrugs= thod rlon lnga bcu'i phreng bas sku la brgyan: sems byung 'khrul rtog= nyi ma zla ba'i snyan rgyan wang mig ldan: gnyis 'dzin 'khor ba= phyag drug g.yas kyi dang pos rtse dgu 'dzin: chos kyi bden pa= bar pas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa yis: dug lnga'i 'khrul 'khor=

g.yon gyi dang pos ye shes me dpung 'dzin: ma rig gzung 'dzin= bar pas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams pa yis: dug gsum 'khrul pa= zhabs bzhi gyad kyi 'dor stabs bgrad pa yis: mtha' bzhi'i rgol ba= sku la dur khrod dpal chas ldan pa yis: tshogs yul rtog tshogs= rig stong gnyis med bde chen rnal 'byor ma: sbyor ba'i yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mas: mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad sdang ba'i 107)dgra la bzlog: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan 'dzin tshe bsring chos sgrub bar chad bzlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dgra la bzlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu= glo bur dgu bcu rtsa brgyad= ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu= dgra bgegs sri ngan za kha= nad rims mtshon 'khrugs bskal ngan= phyugs kyi god kha ngan pa= sde brgyad khengs 'khrugs g.yul ngo= mi kha gyod sna thams cad= mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad= sdang bar byed pa'i dgra dpung thams cad bzlog: gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rnams rdul du rlog: phrin las dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ bh+yo: shar phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas: me long ye shes dbyings las bzhengs pa'i lha: dpal chen khro rgyal badz+ra kī la ya: chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: zhe sdang las gyur dgra bgegs bzlog cing sgrol: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dgra la bzlog: bgegs rigs sogs nas: phrin las dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐: lho phyogs 'khor lo= 108)mnyam nyid ye shes dbyings las skur sprul pa: dpal chen khro rgyal rat+na kī la ya: chos kyi dbyings nas= nga rgyal g.yo 'khrugs= sha khrag dmar= sa ma ya: hūm̐: nub phyogs 'khor lo= sor rtogs ye shes= dpal chen khro rgyal pad+ma kī la ya: chos kyi dbyings nas= 'dod chags g.yo 'khrugs= sha khrag dmar gyi= sa ma ya: hūm̐: byang phyogs 'khor lo= bya grub ye shes=

dpal chen khro rgyal karma kī la ya: chos kyi dbyings nas= phrag dog g.yo 'khrugs= sha khrag dmar gyi= sa ma ya: hūm̐ bh+yo: steng phyogs 'khor lo= khro rgyal hūm̐ kar yab yum sprul 'khor bcas: chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar gyi= lha yi gdon dang dgra bgegs bzlog cing sgrol: hūm̐: shar phyogs 'khor lo= khro chen rnam rgyal yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar gyi= dri za'i gdon tshogs= hūm̐: shar lho 'khor lo= khro rgyal dbyu+ug sngon yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar= me lha'i gdon dang dgregs= hūm̐: lho phyogs 'khor lo= khro rgyal gshin rje yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar gyi= gshin rje'i gdon tshogs= hūm̐: lho nub 'khor lo= khro rgyal mi g.yo yab yum= 109)chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar gyi= srin po'i gdon tshogs= nad rigs bzhi brgya= sogs nas: sa ma ya: hūm̐ bh+yo: nub phyogs 'khor lo= khro rgyal rta mgrin yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar gyi= chu lha'i gdon tshogs= hūm̐ḥ nub byang 'khor lo= khro chen 'dod rgyal yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar gyi= rlung lha'i gdon tshogs= hūm̐: byang phyogs 'khor lo= khro rgyal bdud 'khyil yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar gyi= gnod sbyin gdon tshogs= hūm̐: byang shar 'khor lo= khro chen khams gsum rnam rgyal yab yum 'khor: chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar gyi= dbang ldan gdon dang= hūm̐: 'og phyogs 'khor lo= khro rgyal stobs chen yab yum= chos kyi dbyings nas= sha khrag dmar gyi= sa bdag gdon dang= nad rigs bzhi brgya= sogs nas/ sa ma ya: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal chen sku gsung thugs sprul sras dang ni: za gsod las byed pho nya phra thabs sde: sgo skyong ma bzhi dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang: dpal gyi bka' srung dam can ma mo'i tshogs: drag khros rngams pa'i sku ru da bzhengs la: dgra bgegs sha khrag don snying bcas pa rol:

110)gzugs can gzugs med dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bzlog: bstan 'dzin tshe bsring chos sgrub bar chad bzlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya= sogs nas: sa ma ya: dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams kyi steng du bsgyur cig bzlog cig: e sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: de ltar drag bzlog zab mo 'dir brtson pas: chos sgrub skyes bu'i phyi nang bar chad zhi: gang brtsam las kun gegs med 'grub par nges: sa ma ya: e ma: bdag 'dra bud med ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skyes bu'i don ched du: bi d+yo ta ma'i bcud phyungs man ngag 'di: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la bdag gis zhus: ma 'ongs don du mi 'gyur brda ru btab: smon lam 'phro ldan zhi ba mtsho la gdams: da dung ma spel rin chen gter rgyas thob: ma 'ongs nyi shu kha ral dus kyi tsheḥ snyigs ma'i 'gro ba'i blo kha bdud kyis bsgyur: las su 'phrog bcom dmag 'khrugs kho nas 'da': sngar mi dar ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'byung: rang gzhan mi 'dod la yog rang gis bsgrub: mtha' 'dre 'byung po'i smon log bod du dar: chos sgrub yongs la bar chad sna tshogs brtsam: dam sri mi ru brdzus nas chos ltar bcos: dge bcu'i chos spyod na bun bzhin du yal: dge med sdig stong nag po kha 'byams kyis: log lam sems can mang po 'khrul par 'khyams: bdud sprul 111) smon log gcug gi nor bzhin brten: chos bzhin spyod pa'i skyes bu'i sku la bsdo: rang gzhan gnyis phung mi dge sna tshogs byed: bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku tshe chos srid nyams: 'gro la sngar med nad yams sna tshogs dar: de dag dul dang rang byas rkyen las byung: gso dpyad sman gyis phan pa gang la srid: de sogs dus ngan rang rtags ngoms pa'i tshe: khyod sprul su kha badz+ra khyim ba'i tshul: pad+ma'i rigs can yos sam 'grub longs: gnas gsum a tām̐ hūm̐ dang ha ri dang: ni sa swā hā la sogs yi ge bkra:

mi srin lcags khams 'dul ba'i dpal du ni: tha mal tshul can smon lam dbang gis 'byung: log smon sa p+ta'i rkyen gyis ma bsgyur na: thabs grogs mchog gsum ya bzhi chos bdag bcu: bu slob las can brgya phrag dang 'phrad nas: chos 'di'i bstan pa yul gru gsum du dar: 'dir 'phrad skyes bu'i tshe chos bar chad sel: don gnyis mdzad pa phrin las mthar phyin 'gyur: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung gnod sbyin gza' dang ma mos srungs: dam nyams snod min rnams la gnyer gyis shig: rigs ldan snying gi bu la chos 'di sprod: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang rang slob dam pa rnal 'byor kar don dang nye 112) gnas tshul khrims rdo rje/ bu mo chos dbyings sgrol ma sogs kyis nan cher bskul ngor kun bzang chos nyid dbang mos nyams chos yi ge'i ris su bris pa'o// dge'o//
